rules.preambleClass: the 2026-09-01 rule, verbatim in preambleClass(): jepson = opens "In a"; crm = computer-readable/usable, storage medium or program product in the first 120 characters; method = "[a|an] [computer-implemented] method" head; system = [a|an] + up to two modifiers + system|apparatus|device|server|terminal|controller|circuit; other = the rest
rules.transition: the LAST transition word in the attorney’s preamble row; the text after it is the tail ("the steps of")
rules.opener: the leading noun phrase up to the first purpose or body word (for / of / to / configured / having / storing / comprising ...); over eight words is no opener
rules.skeleton: opener, the connector that introduces the purpose, the purpose as "...", a closing re-mention of the head noun (", the method") when present, the transition, and a "the steps of" tail
rules.template: opener kept; after it only frame tokens are kept, in order, an article only before a head word, every other run of words collapsed to "..."; the transition closes it
